title: Manual page
description: One record per Manual page. Holds everything that is constant across the chunks cut from it, so those fields are stored once and joined rather than copied onto every chunk.

part_id.description: From the sidebar nav tree ONLY. Never inferred from the URL slug — slugs collide across Parts (32A.2.3 and 32B.2.3 share one, distinguished by a trailing '1').

nav_title.description: As it appears in the sidebar.

examples: 22.1. Registrability under section 41 of the Trade Marks Act 1995

content_hash.description: Whole-page hash. Cheap gate for the crawler: unchanged page, skip chunking entirely.

archived.description: The page carries the Manual's 'This page has been archived.' banner. It keeps its nav entry, its title and its amendment history, and has no prose left, so it yields no chunks. Distinct from retirement, which is a page leaving the nav altogether and moving to pages/_retired/.

last_amended.description: Most recent date in the page's 'Amended Reasons' table.

amendment_note.description: IP Australia's own words for the most recent change — 'Minor updates.', 'Update hyperlinks'. Lets a reviewer separate substantive practice change from cosmetic edits without reading the diff.

extractor_version.description: When this changes, chunks may need rebuilding even though the source text did not.
